title: Hardness of approximating deterministic communication complexity of partial Boolean functions

license.adaptation_notice: Faithful editable transcription of the official CCC2020 CC BY3.0 publication, article22. Independent partial-Boolean communication-minimization theme: complete Section5.1 source definitions19--31 and cited coloring-hardness20/21 premises, complete Section5.2 graph-to-partial-matrix construction and Theorem32 author proof, complete Section5.3 original Corollaries33/34 with author deductions and Theorem35 full approximate-characterization impossibility proof. All82 official bibliography entries retained using the shared frozen formal-source bibliography. Original partial{0,1,*} matrix, unrestricted deterministic two-party protocol/leaf/depth/cover/DAG measures, approximation ratios/error and eventual monotonicity/gap conditions retained. No fixed-round or total-function theorem substituted. Original printed references/wording retained without mathematical repair, including Section5.3 reference to balanced protocol as proofTheorem20 and source DAG counting statement. Standard external graph-coloring hardness retained at author citation boundary, without recursive proof. All direct parameter consequences/communication measures grouped once. Finite comparison to NT065: that item uses CCC2021.31 deterministic totalBoolean fixed-round protocol-size hardness with a Boolean construction and round elimination; this item uses CCC2020.22 partialBoolean matrices, arbitrary depth and coloring-cover characterization. Distinct model, main result and mechanism. Native not available in bounded author/source lookup; all selected TeX transcribed from formally licensed PDF. No necessary figures. Root handles compilation/database/publication.

standard_prerequisites.name: Gap hardness of graph coloring
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Exact original Theorem20[82] and Theorem21[79] statements retained; no recursion into prior hardness proofs.

core_obligations: Preserve partialBoolean rather than total matrix and deterministic two-party rather than fixed-round model.
Keep complete graph-to-matrix/coloring/rectangle cover proof and all source measure definitions.
Retain original ratio/additive-error and lambda/eta eventual-monotonicity gap statements and complete characterization-impossibility proof.
Group direct measure and parameter consequences once; retain finite comparison to NT065.
difficulty_reason: The author encodes graph nonedges as undefined matrix entries so color classes give small protocols and every positive rectangle cover yields a coloring. Combining two distinct coloring gaps with balanced protocols transfers hardness to leaf/cover/depth measures and rules out broad monotone polynomial-time approximate characterizations. This is an explicit nonroutine communication-reduction mechanism.

dedup.scope: Same source root DOI/ECCC query was zero beforeNT071 intake. NT071 is the distinct multioutput circuit random-reduction result. Finite semantic comparison to frozenNT065 (CCC2021.31,totalBoolean,fixedround deterministicleafcount) confirms this item is CCC2020.22 partial{0,1,*}, arbitrarydepth deterministic complexity and graphcoloring/cover construction. These source/model/main-mechanism differences preserve independent scope; support/parameter consequences grouped.
